defs.meaning: 锦标赛，联赛（tournament 的复数）

examples.en: Seles won 10 tournaments, and was the undisputed world champion.
examples.zh: 塞莱斯赢了10次锦标赛，是无异议的世界冠军。

examples.en: It was all a far cry from those halcyon days in 1990, when he won three tournaments on the European tour.
examples.zh: 这和1990年的那些美好时光迥然不同，当时他在欧洲巡回赛中赢了三场锦标赛。

examples.en: He won 11 of his 12 claycourt tournaments in 2005, including his first slam at the French Open.
examples.zh: 2005年，他在红土赛场的12场比赛中赢了11场，包括他在法网的第一次大满贯。
